sentences: It's important to me that you feel supported and empowered as you begin your journey here at STARTED.
Don't hesitate to reach out if any questions come up or if there's anything else you'd like to discuss.
It's important that we maintain consistency across our code base.
From now on, when naming attributes, I want you to end the name with the suffix '_xt'.
This is a convention we use in our team to distinguish certain attributes and improve code readability.
Yes, this convention is especially useful when dealing with cross-platform or cross-technology interactions.
If you have any questions or come across any unique scenarios, feel free to reach out.
Consistency is key in software engineering, and it's important that we all follow the same conventions.
